originalPassage.title: The Hidden Workshop
originalPassage.topic: A child discovers an old garden shed and uncovers its forgotten purpose
originalPassage.readingLevel: Age 9 (simpler narrative structure, shorter sentences than original UK Year 6/age 11 test)
originalPassage.summary: Maya finds an abandoned workshop in her grandmother's garden shed and learns that her grandmother was a skilled furniture maker in her youth. Through exploration and dialogue, she discovers forgotten tools, sketches, and a half-finished wooden chest. Maya realizes she has inherited her grandmother's creativity.

questionTypesCovered.description: Which word is closest in meaning to [word from passage]?
Why did [character] do [action]? or What made [character] realize [something]?
examples: Q4: Why did Grandma stop making furniture?
Q5: Why was Maya surprised to find the chest?

questionTypesCovered.description: Is this statement true or false based on the passage?
examples: Q1: Maya knew about her grandmother's hobby from the start
Q7: Grandma had finished the wooden chest

questionTypesCovered.description: Which event happened first/last? or Put events in order
examples: Q3: Order of events in the discovery

questionTypesCovered.description: Which sentence/phrase shows that [character] felt/was [emotion or state]?
examples: Q6: Evidence that Maya cared about her grandmother's work
Q8: Evidence that the workshop had been forgotten
